name: pokemon-go-toolkit
description: Look up Pokémon GO data, calculate CP, PvP IV ranks and power-up costs, and compare Pokémon sizes and Showcase potential.

interface.longDescription: Find sourced information about Pokémon, forms, moves, PvP, and raids. Calculate CP, stats, league limits, IV ranks, and power-up costs. Use the Showcase skill to compare sizes, estimate scores, and help decide which Pokémon to keep.
defaultPrompt: Calculate the league endpoint and IV rank for this Pokémon.
Compare the power-up costs for these Pokémon builds.
Use exact calculations to answer this incomplete Pokémon GO question.
